scope: Six real standing crop states, neutral tray and separate ground decoration. No runtime integration claim.

frames.description: Low spray of fine branching leaves gathered at one quiet ground crown.
frames.actualUse: Gladroot's actual second and final standing stage; yield stays below ground.
frames.limits: No exposed root, ripe carrot, harvest flag or new third stage. Completion releases yield and removes the crop.

frames.description: A narrow unequal cluster of upright stalks and long green leaf blades without filled grain heads.
frames.actualUse: Actual stage1 before automatic produce release; unfilled immature grain silhouette.
frames.limits: No ripe kernel head or standing ripe frame. Existing RipeCropRow remains a different owner.

frames.description: Two low broad angular leaves rising from a dark knuckled crown.
frames.actualUse: The middle growing stage of the real harvest-at-maturity root crop.
frames.limits: No ripe clay shoulder or loose harvested clod is visible yet. Crop ownership does not require Vegetation tag.

frames.description: Broad leaves above attached knuckled red-clay shoulders with root ridges.
frames.actualUse: Actual mature unharvested MarlrootCrop; harvest releases clods and a seed through simulation.
frames.limits: One growing plant, not a loose FireClay pile, loose clod item or fixed yield-count pictogram.

frames.description: A slim stem with two opposed pointed leaves and one small central growing tip.
frames.actualUse: The middle stage of the actual harvest-at-maturity resin crop.
frames.limits: No amber resin or paper pods before maturity; no flowering interpretation.

frames.description: Paired olive leaves with two angular hanging paper pods and a small amber resin bead.
frames.actualUse: Actual mature unharvested resin crop; products and seed appear only through real harvest.
frames.limits: Pods are not round flowers, lamps, flame, a brewing effect or a promise of a fixed visible yield.

frames.description: A shallow worn wooden sorting tray with two small cord loops and an empty open center.
frames.actualUse: Existing non-solid ContainerPart owner; neutral contents-independent identity.
frames.limits: No painted seed, stock, loot promise, chest lock, permission color or new open/closed state.

frames.description: Asymmetric short twine runs with small tie knots laid flat near a bed's edges; fully transparent center.
frames.actualUse: Decoration only on the two actual bound claimed ground owners; survives crop removal.
frames.limits: No fence, collision, seed/contents count, permission color or full-cell border. Not a standalone owner.
